key_insight: GDSW-type coarse spaces support scalable high-order 3D domain decomposition, but VEM requires moment-based representation of operator kernels to preserve coarse-level effectiveness for polynomial degrees k ≥ 3.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners can improve iterative solution of large 3D Poisson and linear-elasticity systems using high-order FEM or VEM.
method: Study two-level overlapping additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW, GDSW*, and RGDSW coarse spaces.
Represent operator kernels through face moments when constructing VEM coarse basis functions.
Evaluate FEM on hexahedral meshes and VEM on hexahedral and polyhedral meshes.
evidence_signal: Tests cover polynomial degrees up to k = 5 and up to 4,096 subdomains and parallel cores, showing scalable Poisson iteration counts across all variants and extension of the moment-based construction to linear elasticity.
watch_item: High-order VEM coarse-space construction is not purely algebraic: omitting the moment correction makes the coarse level ineffective for k ≥ 3.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 3D
